question: A circle is inscribed in ΔABC, touching AB, BC and AC at the points P, Q and R, respectively. If AB - BC = 4 cm, AB - AC = 2 cm and the perimeter of ΔABC = 36 cm, then PB + AR (in cm ) is:
solution:
**Given:**

AB - BC = 4

AB - AC = 2

Perimeter = 36

Calculation:

Let AB = c, BC = a, AC = b

Semiperimeter s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

AP = AR = s - a

BP = s - b

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba182734d11265bbed2e860e3726950db87764bbf0af4fef0645dcc2f3919c80.png] 

⇒ c - a = 4

⇒ c - b = 2

⇒ a + b + c = 36

⇒ a = c - 4, b = c - 2

⇒ (c - 4) + (c - 2) + c = 36

⇒ 3c - 6 = 36

⇒ 3c = 42

⇒ c = 14

⇒ a = 10, b = 12

⇒ s = (10 + 12 + 14) ÷ 2 = 18

⇒ PB = s - b = 18 - 12 = 6

⇒ AR = s - a = 18 - 10 = 8

⇒ PB + AR = 6 + 8 = 14

**∴ The correct answer is 14.**
